39198-random-rhymes-and-rambles.creator: Unknown
39198-random-rhymes-and-rambles.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. but rudely said;  Tho thay may chear some stricken heart,  Or raise some wretched head;  For thay are words I love mysel,  They’re music to my ear;  Thay muster up fresh energy  Ta chase each dout an’ fear.

arxiv-2011-00017.title: MHV Gluon Scattering Amplitudes from Celestial Current Algebras
arxiv-2011-00017.creator: Shamik Banerjee, Sudip Ghosh
arxiv-2011-00017.description: Abstract We show that the Mellin transform of an n n -point tree level MHV gluon scattering amplitude, also known as the celestial amplitude in pure Yang-Mills theory, satisfies a system of ( n − 2 ) (n-2) linear first order partial differential equations corresponding to ( n − 2 ) (n-2) positive helicity gluons.

arxiv-2101-06101.title: On the relation of the COVID-19 reproduction number to the explosive timescales: the case of Italy Journal: arXiv.org
arxiv-2101-06101.creator: Dimitris G. Patsatzis
arxiv-2101-06101.description: Abstract A great issue of discussion of an infectious disease is its basic reproduction number R 0 R_{0} , which provides an estimation of the contagiousness of the disease. When R 0 > 1 R_{0}>1 , the disease spread will potentially lead to an outbreak, such that of the ongoing COVID-19 pandemics.

arxiv-2105-13316.title: Narrow-band giant pulses from the Crab pulsar 2021 Narrow-band giant pulses from the Crab pulsar – References
arxiv-2105-13316.creator: Parasar Thulasiram, Hsiu-Hsien Lin
arxiv-2105-13316.description: Abstract We used a new spectral-fitting technique to identify a subpopulation of 6 narrow-band giant pulses from the Crab pulsar out of a total of 1578. These giant pulses were detected in 77 minutes of observations with the 46-m dish at the Algonquin Radio Observatory at 400–800 MHz.

arxiv-2106-07909.title: Evaluating the Effect of the Financial Status to the Mobility Customs
arxiv-2106-07909.creator: Gergő Pintér, Imre Felde
arxiv-2106-07909.description: Abstract In this article, we explore the relationship between cellular phone data and housing prices in Budapest, Hungary. We determine mobility indicators from one months of Call Detail Records (CDR) data, while the property price data are used to characterize the socioeconomic status at the Capital of Hungary.

arxiv-2112-08150.title: On the Photoproduction Reactions γ ​ d → π ​ N ​ N \gamma d\to\pi N\!N
arxiv-2112-08150.creator: William J. Briscoe, Alexander E. Kudryavtsev, Igor I. Strakovsky, Vladimir E. Tarasov, Ron L. Workman
arxiv-2112-08150.description: Abstract A review of our works providing a theoretical description of incoherent pion photoproduction on the deuteron is presented. The existing γ ​ d → π ​ N ​ N \gamma d\to\pi N\!N data are analysed, especially those obtained more recently by the CLAS Collaboration at JLab, the A2 Collaboration at MAMI at Mainz, and the PION@MAX-lab Collaboration at Lund.

arxiv-2205-11300.title: Designing Conversational Robots with Children during the Pandemic Conference: 6th International and Interdisciplinary Perspectives on Children & Recommender and Information Retrieval Systems (KidRec) Information Retrieval Systems for Children in the COVID-19 Era; co-located with ACM IDC; June 27,2 0
arxiv-2205-11300.creator: Thomas Beelen, Ella Velner, Roeland Ordelman, Khiet P. Truong, Vanessa Evers, Theo Huibers
arxiv-2205-11300.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Thomas Beelen, Ella Velner, Roeland Ordelman, Khiet P. Truong, Vanessa Evers, Theo Huibers. Our research project (CHATTERS) is about designing a conversational robot for children’s digital information search. We want to design a robot with a suitable conversation, that fosters a responsible trust relationship between child and robot. In this paper we give: 1) a preliminary view on an empirical study around children’s trust in robots that provide information, which was conducted via video call due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

arxiv-2206-07757.title: Morphological study of a sample of dwarf tidal galaxies using the C − A C-A plane
arxiv-2206-07757.creator: I. Vega-Acevedo, and A. M. Hidalgo-Gámez
arxiv-2206-07757.description: Abstract Los parámetros morfológicos Concentración, C C , y Asimetría, A A , pueden ayudar a identificar si una galaxia enana es candidata a ser una Tidal Dwarf Galaxy (TDG). Se calcularon los valores de C C y A A en el óptico de una muestra de galaxias que son TDG o candidatas a serlo.

arxiv-2208-05106.title: The LHCb state P ψ ​ s Λ ​ ( 4338 ) P_{\psi s}^{\Lambda}(4338) as a triangle singularity
arxiv-2208-05106.creator: T. J. Burns, E. S. Swanson
arxiv-2208-05106.description: Abstract We present a model for the J / ψ ​ Λ J/\psi\,\Lambda spectrum in B − → J / ψ ​ Λ ​ p ¯ B^{-}\to J/\psi\,\Lambda\,\bar{p} decays, including the P ψ ​ s Λ ​ ( 4338 ) P_{\psi s}^{\Lambda}(4338) baryon recently observed by the LHCb collaboration.

arxiv-2303-15505.title: Magic Angles In Equal-Twist Trilayer Graphene
arxiv-2303-15505.creator: Fedor K. Popov and Grigory Tarnopolsky
arxiv-2303-15505.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Fedor K. Popov and Grigory Tarnopolsky. We consider a configuration of three stacked graphene monolayers with equal consecutive twist angles θ \theta . Remarkably, in the chiral limit when interlayer coupling terms between AA sites of the moiré pattern are neglected we find four perfectly flat bands (for each valley) at a sequence of magic angles which are exactly equal to the twisted bilayer graphene (TBG) magic angles divided by 2 \sqrt{2} .

arxiv-2310-13507.title: Matsumoto theorem for skeleta
arxiv-2310-13507.creator: M. Gorelik, V. Hinich, V. Serganova
arxiv-2310-13507.description: Abstract . We present a proof of a generalization of the theorem of H. Matsumoto on Coxeter groups. Our generalized version is applicable to “graphs admitting geometric realization”. The original version of the theorem for Coxeter groups is a special case when applied to the Cayley graph and the geometric representation of a Coxeter group.

arxiv-2401-03011.title: A Note on the Complexity of Graph Recoloring The author is supported by ANR project GrR (ANR-18-CE40-0032).
arxiv-2401-03011.creator: Nicolas Bousquet
arxiv-2401-03011.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Nicolas Bousquet. We say that a graph is k k -mixing if it is possible to transform any k k -coloring into any other via a sequence of single vertex recolorings keeping a proper coloring all along. Cereceda, van den Heuvel and Johnson proved that deciding if a graph is 3 3 -mixing is co-NP-complete and left open the case k ≥ 4 k\geq 4 . We prove that for every k ≥ 4 k\geq 4 , k k -mixing is co-NP-hard.

arxiv-2402-08314.title: Willy Wonka Mechanisms
arxiv-2402-08314.creator: Thomas Archbold Bart de Keijzer Carmine Ventre
arxiv-2402-08314.description: Abstract Bounded rationality in mechanism design aims to ensure incentive-compatibility for agents who are cognitively limited. These agents lack the contingent reasoning skills that traditional mechanism design assumes, and depending on how these cognitive limitations are modelled this alters the class of incentive-compatible mechanisms.

arxiv-2407-18291.title: The X-ray Luminous Type Ibn SN 2022ablq: Estimates of Pre-explosion Mass Loss and Constraints on Precursor Emission
arxiv-2407-18291.creator: C. Pellegrino, M. Modjaz, Y. Takei, D. Tsuna, M. Newsome, T. Pritchard, R. Baer-Way, K. A. Bostroem, P. Chandra, P. Charalampopoulos, Y. Dong, J. Farah, D. A. Howell, C. McCully, S. Mohamed, E. Padilla Gonzalez, G. Terreran
arxiv-2407-18291.description: Abstract Type Ibn supernovae (SNe Ibn) are rare stellar explosions powered primarily by interaction between the SN ejecta and H-poor, He-rich material lost by their progenitor stars. Multi-wavelength observations, particularly in the X-rays, of SNe Ibn constrain their poorly-understood progenitor channels and mass-loss mechanisms.

arxiv-2506-09648.title: Scaling Laws for Uncertainty in Deep Learning
arxiv-2506-09648.creator: Mattia Rosso, Simone Rossi, Giulio Franzese, Markus Heinonen, Maurizio Filippone
arxiv-2506-09648.description: Abstract Deep learning has recently revealed the existence of scaling laws, demonstrating that model performance follows predictable trends based on dataset and model sizes. Inspired by these findings and fascinating phenomena emerging in the over-parameterized regime, we examine a parallel direction: do similar scaling laws govern predictive uncertainties in deep learning?

arxiv-2509-07014.title: Loss Functions for Detecting Outliers in Panel Data This paper reports the general results of research undertaken by Census Bureau Staff. The views expressed are attributable to the authors and do not necessarily reflect those of the Census Bureau. The authors would like to thank participants in a S
arxiv-2509-07014.creator: Charles D. Coleman, Thomas Bryan
arxiv-2509-07014.description: Abstract The detection of outliers is of critical importance in the assurance of data quality. Outliers may exist in observed data or in data derived from these observed data, such as estimates and forecasts. An outlier may indicate a problem with its data generation process or may simply be a true statement about the world.

pmc-10654715.title: BubbleDrive, a low-volume incubation chamber for acute brain slices
pmc-10654715.creator: Aditi Naik, Vidar Jensen, Cecilie Bugge Bakketun, Rune Enger, Sabina Hrabetova, Jan Hrabe
pmc-10654715.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Acute brain slices are a common and useful preparation in experimental neuroscience. A wide range of incubation chambers for brain slices exists but only a few are designed with very low volumes of the bath solution in mind. Such chambers are necessary when high-cost chemicals are to be added to the solution or when small amounts of substances released by the slice are to be collected for analysis.

pmc-10656883.title: EFL learners’ boredom coping strategies: the role of teacher-student rapport and support
pmc-10656883.creator: Yanbo Zhang
pmc-10656883.description: BackgroundA significant issue in the language education context is examining the coping strategies that learners apply to combat boredom in the class environment. As a significant contextual element affecting different dimensions of learners’ acquisition, teacher support in general education has been extensively studied but widely neglected in the English as a Foreign Language (EFL) setting.

pmc-10747763.title: Investigation of Novel Solid Dielectric Material for Transformer Windings
pmc-10747763.creator: Aysel Ersoy, Fatih Atalar, Alper Aydoğan, Zhuohong Yang, Chang-An Xu
pmc-10747763.description: Improvement techniques aimed at enhancing the dielectric strength and minimizing the dielectric loss of insulation materials have piqued the interest of many researchers. It is worth noting that the electrical breakdown traits of insulation material are determined by their electrochemical and mechanical performance. Possible good mechanical, electrical, and chemical properties of new materials are considered during the generation process.

pmc-11427677.title: Protein language models are performant in structure-free virtual screening
pmc-11427677.creator: Hilbert Yuen In Lam, Jia Sheng Guan, Xing Er Ong, Robbe Pincket, Yuguang Mu
pmc-11427677.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Hitherto virtual screening (VS) has been typically performed using a structure-based drug design paradigm. Such methods typically require the use of molecular docking on high-resolution three-dimensional structures of a target protein—a computationally-intensive and time-consuming exercise. This work demonstrates that by employing protein language models and molecular graphs as inputs to a novel graph-to-transformer cross-attention mechanism, a screening power comparable to state-of-the-art structure-based models can be achieved.

pmc-11476745.title: Opportunities for Riboswitch Inhibition by Targeting Co-Transcriptional RNA Folding Events
pmc-11476745.creator: Christine Stephen, Danea Palmer, Tatiana V. Mishanina
pmc-11476745.description: Antibiotic resistance is a critical global health concern, causing millions of prolonged bacterial infections every year and straining our healthcare systems. Novel antibiotic strategies are essential to combating this health crisis and bacterial non-coding RNAs are promising targets for new antibiotics. In particular, a class of bacterial non-coding RNAs called riboswitches has attracted significant interest as antibiotic targets.

pmc-11491658.title: A rare finding of pulmonary nodules in a middle ear neuroendocrine tumor: a case report and review of the literature
pmc-11491658.creator: Nader Alharbi, Ghadah Alotaibi, Saleh Alabood, Ibrahim AlSulaiman, Essa Bakry
pmc-11491658.description: Neuroendocrine tumors (NETs) are usually found in the gastrointestinal tract and pancreas; however, they are rare in the middle ear. The presentation of vague symptoms, such as tinnitus and conductive hearing loss, complicates the diagnosis. We present a 46-year-old male with a history of right ear discharge and a previous canal wall-down mastoidectomy, suspected to have cholesteatoma recurrence.

pmc-11508273.title: Clinical Trends and Outcomes in Technology-Assisted Total Hip Arthroplasty
pmc-11508273.creator: Konstantinos Oikonomou, Nicholas R Kiritsis, Haleigh M Hopper, James R Satalich, Conor N O’Neill, Brady Ernst, Jibanananda Satpathy, Enrique Gómez-Barrena
pmc-11508273.description: Background/Objectives: In recent years, there has been a widespread focus on implementing technology in total hip arthroplasty (THA) to further improve precision and outcomes. This study aimed to identify recent trends in the utilization, clinical variables, and rate of adverse events for technology-assisted THA (TA-THA) and compare the outcomes to those of conventional THA.

pmc-11645068.title: An Integration of Deep Neural Network-Based Extended Kalman Filter (DNN-EKF) Method in Ultra-Wideband (UWB) Localization for Distance Loss Optimization
pmc-11645068.creator: Chanthol Eang, Seungjae Lee
pmc-11645068.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This paper examines the critical role of indoor positioning for robots, with a particular focus on small and confined spaces such as homes, warehouses, and similar environments. We develop an algorithm by integrating deep neural networks (DNNs) with the extended Kalman filter (EKF) method, which is known as DNN-EKF, to obtain an accurate indoor localization for ensuring precise and reliable robot movements within the use of Ultra-Wideband (UWB) technology.

pmc-12743475.title: Digoxin Toxicity at Standard Doses in a Child with Subclinical Elevation of Thyrotrophin: A Case Report
pmc-12743475.creator: Mohammadrafie Khorgami, Mohammad Dalili, Bahareh Karimian
pmc-12743475.description: Digoxin toxicity poses a challenge for patients using the drug. Electrolyte disturbances, renal failure, and drug interactions are common predisposing factors. Hypothyroidism can increase the risk of digoxin toxicity primarily. This research reports a 7-year-old boy receiving digoxin 6 μg/kg/day presented with nausea and second-degree atrioventricular block secondary to ongoing digoxin toxicity.

pmc-13106093.title: Editorial: The association between the nervous system and the stomatognathic system: from etiology to diagnosis and treatment of orofacial pain
pmc-13106093.creator: Liliana Szyszka-Sommerfeld, Magdalena Sycińska-Dziarnowska, Gianrico Spagnuolo, Krzysztof Woźniak
pmc-13106093.description: the Study of Pain, the definition of pain is as follows: “Pain is an unpleasant sensory and emotional experience associated with actual or potential tissue damage, or described in terms of such damage” (2). Pain, whether related to injured tissue, inflammation or functional impairment, is mediated by processing in the nervous system (3).

pmc-13138544.title: Persistent genital arousal disorder: A systematic review of diagnosis, etiology, and treatment approaches (2015–2025)
pmc-13138544.creator: Prasenjit Bhowmik, Muhammad Umair Shafiq, Layla Sultan, Mustafa Ahmad, Abdulla Khaleel Alawadi, Sachin Yallappa
pmc-13138544.description: Persistent genital arousal disorder (PGAD) is a distressing, often debilitating condition of unwanted genital arousal occurring independent of desire and difficult to relieve, with substantial psychosocial burden. We systematically reviewed peer-reviewed studies (2015–2025) to synthesize the evidence for diagnosis, etiology, and treatment. PubMed, Ovid (MEDLINE/Embase), and CINAHL (English-language, human studies; last searched on August 31, 2025) were searched.

pmc-13385379.title: Light- and chemical-induced ciliary signaling governs dorsal/ventral regionalization of human telencephalic organoids
pmc-13385379.creator: Issei S. Shimada, Akari Goto, Yutaka Hashimoto, Hajime Inoue, Takuto Sugawara, Tomohiro Doura, Tsubasa Fujita, Toshiaki Iwata, Riko Shimmoto, Hiroshi Takase, Masayuki Itoh, Shigeki Kiyonaka, Yoichi Kato
pmc-13385379.description: Neural stem/progenitor cells (NPCs) have primary cilia, which are critical organelles for Sonic hedgehog signaling. However, little is known about the components of primary cilia in NPCs and whether manipulating signaling in the cilia is sufficient to alter dorsal/ventral regional identity.

pmc-13681080.title: Why diabetes-related foot ulcers fail to heal despite successful revascularization: closing the patency-to-healing gap: a narrative review
pmc-13681080.creator: Mohamed Magdy Mohamed Badr
pmc-13681080.description: Revascularization is central to limb salvage when a diabetes-related foot ulcer is complicated by peripheral artery disease. However, an open artery does not guarantee wound healing. This patency-to-healing gap arises because repair requires regional perfusion, infection control, mechanical protection, viable tissues, physiological reserves, and coordinated care.

uslaw-usc-t10-s1092.title: 10 U.S.C. § 1092 — Studies and demonstration projects relating to delivery of health and medical care
uslaw-usc-t10-s1092.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s1092.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part II (Personnel); Chapter 55 (Medical And Dental Care). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) (1) The Secretary of Defense, in consultation with the other administering Secretaries, shall conduct studies and demonstration projects on the health care delivery system of the uniformed services with a view to improving the quality, efficiency, convenience, and cost effectiveness.
